commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' The attendance is 16213.

90+6' Arthur Avom (Lorient) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
90+1' Here is a change. Laurent Abergel is going off and Olivier Pantaloni gives the last tactical orders to Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient).
90+1' Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Theo Le Bris.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' Corner kick. Lyon will have an opportunity.

88' A free kick is awarded from a very dangerous distance. It's situated just a few metres from outside the box. Several players gather around the ball, but it seems like Tyler Morton (Lyon) is going to have a crack himself.
86' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Mathieu Vernice blows for a foul. Lyon win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
85' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) throws the chance away as he attempts to produce a shot from inside the box. His attempt simply rattles the right post. The goalkeeper can remain calm.
85' Tyler Morton (Lyon) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

84' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the left side of the goal is far too weak and Yvon Mvogo makes a simple save. The linesman makes the right call and Lyon will have a corner.
83' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
83' Bamba Dieng (Lorient) is adjudged offside.

82' Dermane Karim (Lorient) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
79' The linesman points to the corner flag, Lyon are going to take it.

79' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Yvon Mvogo. The ball goes out for a corner. Lyon can continue in their attacking effort.
79' An attempted cross from Pavel Sulc (Lyon) is cleared.
78' Substitution. Jean-Victor Makengo makes his way off the pitch and Noah Cadiou (Lorient) comes on as his replacement.
77' The linesman signals a throw-in for Lorient.
76' Lyon string together a series of short passes.
74' The percentage of ball possession is – 41:59.
71' Pablo Pagis goes off the pitch and Dermane Karim (Lorient) comes on.
71' Olivier Pantaloni prepares a substitution. Sambou Soumano is replaced by Bamba Dieng (Lorient).
70' We are about to witness a substitution. Afonso Moreira (Lyon) is replacing Nicolas Tagliafico.
69' Looks like Arthur Avom (Lorient) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

67' Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Dominik Greif tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
66' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mathieu Vernice had an easy-decision to make.
64' A wild effort from Pavel Sulc (Lyon) on the edge of the box flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
63' Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
62' Lorient are seeing far more of the ball now.
60' Lyon are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
58' Tempers flare after Sambou Soumano (Lorient) commits a foul. He receives a yellow card for his bad challenge and surely must be relieved at not receiving a red card.
56' Lyon win a corner.
49' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Mathieu Vernice no option but to blow his whistle.
46' Here's the change. Mathys de Carvalho leaves the pitch and Hans Hateboer (Lyon) comes on as a substitute.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Tyler Morton (Lyon) commits a rough foul. Mathieu Vernice stops the game and makes a call. A free kick has been awarded to Lorient.
43' The referee can't ignore those comments and Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) sees a yellow card for bad language.
43' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) seems to have forgotten that he has already received a yellow card as he is surprised when the referee shows him a second one!
40' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
39' 1 - 0 Pablo Pagis (Lorient) gets on the end of a perfect cross after one of the defenders fails to clear and strikes the ball inside the left post!
37' The referee shows the yellow card to Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon).
37' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Yvon Mvogo easily deals with the threat.
36' A loose ball is pounced on by Pavel Sulc (Lyon) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Yvon Mvogo is alert and makes a comfortable save.
36' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) receives a cross from the resulting free kick and shoots! However, his effort from just outside the box only hits the right post. What an opportunity!
35' Mathys de Carvalho (Lyon) trips an opposition player and Mathieu Vernice signals a foul.
31' Lyon can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
30' Martin Satriano (Lyon) heads the ball towards goal, but the goalkeeper denies his effort by making an easy save.
29' Sambou Soumano (Lorient) heads the ball towards goal, but his effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
26' A spell of possession for Lyon in an attempt to control the game.

25' Tyler Morton (Lyon) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
23' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
18' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Mathieu Vernice saw the whole situation.
18' Lyon fail to score from a corner as Yvon Mvogo (Lorient) leaps to collect the ball.
16' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) attempts to find Sambou Soumano, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
15' The resulting set piece from Lyon is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
15' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
14' The ball is out of play. Lorient will have a throw-in.
10' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) makes a strong challenge and Mathieu Vernice blows for a foul. Lyon win a free kick.
9' Lorient get a corner.

9' Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom right corner, but Dominik Greif thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
5' Tyler Morton (Lyon) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle for a foul. Lorient are awarded a free kick.
5' The Lorient players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
2' The ball has crossed the sideline. Lorient are taking a throw-in.
1' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Mathieu Vernice has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Lorient have a free kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Lorient will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Mathieu Vernice.
